name: super-face
description: A character on the Mac desktop you talk to: it hears you (Moonshine), thinks with one local model (Ollama), uses your scripts and flows through Tool Mac Tool Run, sets itself reminders, learns, and answers out loud with lip-sync and expressions (Kokoro through HeadTTS, TalkingHead). Served over HTTP to any app.

scripts.dist: node scripts/vendor.mjs && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/check-package.mjs && node scripts/package-mac.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Super Face listens for what you say to it while it's showing.
